content.text: {"core": "Flourishing rests inside what has already grown well — it stops working the ground and lets the yield stand as proof that the tending held. In Nurturing, that ease settles onto the very thing that does the growing, the caretaking itself. Overdone, the resting spreads until the tending stops: nothing new is started, no fresh ground is broken, and the whole store lives off what was already gathered.", "sheetLine": "The harvest is in, so the planting stopped; the store only spends what was already grown."}
